articleTitle: Comparison of Support Vector Machine and Softmax Classifiers in Computer Vision
publicationTitle: 2017 Second International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: Support Vector Machine and Softmax are two widely used linear classifiers in computer vision. Especially in the field of deep learning algorithms, the application of these two classifiers is more frequent. In addition, in the field of statistics, speech recognition, character recognition and other aspects that Support Vector Machine and Softmax also have been used. However, there are still some controversies of these two classifiers in the specific implementations. And the understanding of them comes to a significance place in deep learning process. This paper will make a comparison and analysis of the two classifiers from a holistic perspective to help the reader have a more comprehensive understanding of the two classifiers.

articleTitle: Review of Vertical Take-Off and Landing Aircraft
publicationTitle: 2017 Second International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: vertical takeoff and landing aircrafts are widely concerned due to its unique advantages. In this paper, technical characteristics and development trends of thrust vector vertical takeoff and landing (VTOL) aircrafts, tilted rotor vertical takeoff and landing aircrafts and flight power systems are introduced, based on the existing vertical takeoff and landing aircraft. Design methods of thrust vector flight control are studied based on the vertical takeoff and landing unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV). Developments of vertical takeoff and landing aircraft are prospected in this paper.

articleTitle: Software Reconfiguration Technology for Serviceable Satellite OBDH System
publicationTitle: 2017 Second International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: According to the serviceable satellite software reconfiguration requirements for on-orbit module replacement, a dynamic task migration scheme was put forward based on the operating system dynamic loading mechanism, including task module loading and unloading. In this way, task level software modules could be deployed on any distributed computing units . After the ORU module fails, the function can be recovered through the migration of the tasks. After the replacement of the ORU module, the original tasks can be dynamically migrated back, which was also useful to upgrade on-board software. The task migration mechanism was verified in a practical distributed computing environment.

articleTitle: A Review of Lane Perception and Automobile Control Based on Computer Vision
publicationTitle: 2017 Second International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: Lane Perception and vehicle control are critical components of driverless intelligent vehicles. Lane Perception provides the external information by image processing algorithms. After information processing, the car control system issued a manipulation instructions to achieve autonomous driving. In this paper, related literatures of lane perception and automobile control in recent years are summarized, as well as basic steps and methods of lane perception. Advantages and disadvantages of typical information processing methods and vehicle control methods are listed. The research direction of lane perception and vehicle control based on computer vision is expounded and established, which lays the foundation for the follow-up study.

articleTitle: Development of the Maintenance Robot with Electrification Used in Substation
publicationTitle: 2017 Second International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: The insulators of open-type substation are exposed to the outdoors for a long time. The surfaces have been affected by atmospheric environment such as SO2, nitrogen oxides and granular dust, and it is prone to flashover accidents in wet weather. The steel core aluminum strand of lines in open-type substation which exposed to the outdoor environment for a long time would be broken. The breakage of the transmission lines could reduce the mechanical strength, and then lead to safety accidents when it is serious. The maintenance robot with electrification used in substation works in 110 kV to 220 kV open-type substations. The robot adopts a crawler walking mechanism to move, an insulated arm of folding and telescopic with multi-level combination to and a high power density hydraulic manipulator to work. Different operating tools could be installed at the end of the robot's arm to complete the electrified maintenance tasks, such as the electrified cleaning of the insulators, the dry ice cleaning of the insulators, and repairing the broken wires with electrification.

articleTitle: Application of FMECA Analysis in Mechanical Condition Monitoring of Breaker
publicationTitle: 2017 Second International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: In this paper, the failure mode, the failure influence and fault criticality analysis of the circuit breaker spring operating mechanism are analyzed based on the historical fault data of the breaker in the Xiamen an-dou substation and the analysis of the structural function characteristics of the breaker operating mechanism. According to the conclusion of the analysis, the closing coil current, vibration and acoustic signal are determined as the monitoring parameter of the monitoring system. The limitation of single or single source sensor to the operation state of circuit breaker is overcome by combining data from multi-source sensor.

articleTitle: A P2P Streaming Media Segmentation Method Based on Scalable Video Coding Data Characteristics
publicationTitle: 2017 Second International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: P2P Streaming Media System Based on SVC(Scalable Video Coding) often use equal playback length segmentation method to segment the video data, but the size of the data in different segmentation varies widely using this segmentation method, which can lead to the instability of data transmission in P2P network system. In this case, this paper presents a new segmentation method based on SVC. In the new method, the video data is segmented twice, first segment the video data of each layer according to the number of GOPs(Group of Picture) which should be contained in the segmentation of each layer, and after first segmented, the segmentation of the same layer have the equal playback length, then segment the segmentation of the base layer using the second segmentation method. Finally the experimental results show that the new segmentation based on SVC can reduce the complexity of the enhancement layers scheduling in P2P system and enhance the stability of data transmission in P2P network system, and it is a kind of effective P2P streaming media segmentation method.

articleTitle: An Improving of Load Balancing in Clustering Algorithm for Wireless Sensor Network Based on Distance
publicationTitle: 2017 Second International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: Wireless sensor network is composed of a number of tiny devices with energy constraints, sensing nodes. How the limited energy used effectively is a basic and important considered factor, and the design goal of most wireless sensing network protocols. Researches control the number of clusters in the network by dividing the sensing nodes into groups in advance. However, there is still the problem of unbalanced energy consumption between clusters, resulting in shortened network life. In this report, a way to improve the energy utilization of the network nodes by adjusting the cluster size while considers the load-balancing factor of the network was proposed. The main idea is to adjust the cluster size based on the distance between the groups and the base stations. We use the software simulation to observe its performance, the simulation results show that energy consumption does tend to balance the trend, although its effect is still not ideal, but can determine the size of the cluster on the impact of network power consumption.

articleTitle: A Fusion Detection Algorithm of Motional Ship in Bridge Collision Avoidance System
publicationTitle: 2017 Second International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: This paper proposed a detection algorithm for motional ships in complex inland ship channel based on opencv library. A ROI (Region Of Interest) for the input video frame is first selected. For the image within this ROI, we implemented edge detection and image segmentation. With these preprocessed images, Gaussian Mixture background subtraction method and three framess difference method are fused to detect the object in the foreground. Furthermore, the contour, the area of external rectangle, aspect ratio and other geometric features for the object are calculated. When these features of the object coincide with those of a ship, a rectangular box is added on the target. The experimental results showed that the algorithm can identify the motional a ship reliably, and assist the ship to sail safely.

articleTitle: Robot Control System for Live Maintenance of Substation Equipment
publicationTitle: 2017 Second International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: In order to solve the low degree of automation of the substation robot, the design of live substation equipment maintenance work robot control system, this system mainly includes the ROS system framework, main and auxiliary controller, sensor and actuator. In order to meet the requirements of insulation performance and safety performance of live line robot, a split multi control box system is adopted, and at the same time, a safety protection system with multi-sensor fusion is adopted.

Author Keywords: Transformer substation; Maintenance; Robot; Control system

articleTitle: Transfer Learning for Air Traffic Control LVCSR System
publicationTitle: 2017 Second International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: In order to reduce the accidents due to errors of Air Traffic Control (ATC) directives and do responsibility investigation, it's necessary to recognize the audio of the ATC directives into texts. However, the existing Automatic Speech Recognition (ASR) systems are aimed for isolated word recognition, which can't apply to LVCSR. Thus, we analyze the characteristics of ATC directives and develop Large Vocabulary Continuous Speech Recognition (LVCSR) for it. In addition, to solve the issue, that the data of ATC directives are scarce, we proposed a new crosslingual knowledge transfer learning method, i.e. semi-shared-hidden layers crosslingual (Semi-SHL-CDNN). We demonstrate that the Semi-SHL-CDNN can reduce errors by 16.76%, relatively, over monolingual DNNs. Compared with SHL-MDNN, the WER is reduced by 1.38% extra.

articleTitle: Experimental Study on Cutting Force during Milling Process of 022Cr17Ni12Mo2 Stainless Steel
publicationTitle: 2017 Second International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: In this paper, the multiple factor orthogonal experiment is used to design the experiment of milling 022Cr17Ni12Mo2 stainless steel, from which the cutting forces influenced by cutting parameters such as cutting speed, feed per tooth and cutting depth are collected. The mathematical model of cutting force is established by data processing and linear regression analysis, which also tests the validation of the cutting model and factors of cut, followed by intuitive analysis of orthogonal experimental results. The results show that there is a positive correlation between the feed per tooth and cutting depth, and the effect is highly significant. In the premise of maintaining the metal removal rate unchanged, the use of appropriate control of feed per tooth and maximize the spindle speed and reduce the depth of the way, a number of knives to complete the processing of parts, so that both can control the deformation and can guarantee processing efficiency.

articleTitle: Super-Resolution Deblurring Algorithm for Generative Adversarial Networks
publicationTitle: 2017 Second International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: Image quality improvement has a significant impact on target detection and recognition. Generative Adversarial Nets are inspired by two-person zero-sum game in game theory. It can learn to automatically generate images, which can be conditional learning, a guide to the image generation. In this paper, we analyze the characteristics of motion blur, and propose a method to add the defocused fuzzy kernel and multi-direction motion fuzzy kernel to the training samples, and use the super-resolution anti-network method to exercise blur and carry out the fuzzy image data recorded by the UAV experiment analysis.

articleTitle: A New Spatial Encoding Method for Sparse Binary Data
publicationTitle: 2017 Second International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: Spatial encoding is an important technique for spatial binary data storage, which differentiates the defined data from the undefined data in many computer graphics applications. However, previous methods make significant memory cost when the spatial data becomes very sparse, particularly for high resolution domains. In this paper, we present a new sparse encoding method which has less storage requirement. It is simple and efficient in storing spatial binary data. Our method utilizes commonly used array to store the specific dimensional coordinate for each defined data. To achieve efficient access on the GPUs, we recur to an auxiliary table to record the first defined element of each row. Compared to several popular approaches, the experimental results on 2D images and 3D models demonstrate that our method has a better memory performance on spatial binary data.

articleTitle: Autonomous Road-Traveling and Monitoring Robot
publicationTitle: 2017 Second International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: In order to solve the problem that outdoor patrolling mission will be waste of manpower and material resources, this paper designs an autonomous Road-traveling and Monitoring Robot based on Track Car. This system includes the computer software and track car robot. The user can send the instruction to the crawler robot through the host computer software written in C # language. The tracker robot selects the STM32 as a controller to receive the user's instructions and then enters the manual control mode or the automatic patrol mode. User can establish track car robot's patrolling route through computer software's instruction. The system can effectively deal with outdoor patrolling mission, saving manpower and resources. The experimental results show that the system has the characteristics of smooth operation and strong reliability.

articleTitle: The Motion Control System Based on ARM and Multi-sensor Information Fusion Technology
publicationTitle: 2017 Second International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: Aiming at the construction requirements of "outdoor test field for LED street lamp", an auto test vehicle for outdoor illuminance performance was developed. The test vehicle is consisted of AGV, AGV controller, encoder interface circuit, measurement & control terminal and remote controller. The AGV controller collects signals from encoders and landmark sensors. The position information of AGV is accurately measured by multi-sensor information fusion technology. The AGV controller identifies the parameters dynamically such as kinetic lead, controls the action of AGV. In the AGV motion control system, the AGV positioning error is within 3cm, meet measurement requirements of outdoor test field. Through the interface circuit with measurement & control terminal, the AGV controller can test the related parameters of outdoor LED lamp automatically, such as illuminance parameters and electrical parameters. These parameters can be transmitted to the control center with wireless networks.

articleTitle: Influencing Factors of Parachute-non-Bomb Trajectory in the Fuel-Air Explosives
publicationTitle: 2017 Second International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: The parachute system has been widely applied in modern armament design, especially for the fuel-air explosives. Because detonation of fuel-air explosives occurs during flight, it is necessary to investigate the influences of the parachute-non-bomb drop process on flight characteristics to ensure successful dynamic detonation. In this paper, the major characteristics of parachute-non-bomb phase were explored with airdrop. Based on the influences, the equations for parachute-non-bomb trajectory were established to predict the position of parachute-non-bomb. The characteristics of parachute-bomb and parachute-non-bomb process were analyzed and discussed. The analysis results showed that the parachute-bomb, including parachute and bomb component, swung periodically in the falling stability phase and the parachute-non-bomb trajectory was a straight line toward an angle. The attitude angle, parachute-non-bomb velocity, and delay time were the major influencing factors of the parachute-non-bomb trajectory. Parachute-non-bomb velocity was less than parachute-bomb velocity. The parachute-bomb velocity was 35.73m/s, which was 3.53 m/s less than that of the parachute-non-bomb velocity, 32.2m/s.

articleTitle: Design of an ADSP-Based Distributed Wind Turbines Condition Monitoring System for Wind Farms
publicationTitle: 2017 Second International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: In order to meet the high requirement in data processing and solve the problems in status data acquisition in condition monitoring of the widely distributed wind turbines, a device condition monitoring hardware based on ADSP-BF518 processor was introduced in this paper. The key technologies, such as CPLD-based function expansion, ADC, DAC, synchronization logic and network interface, were presented in details. Besides, a wind turbine bearing online monitoring software system for wind farm is also proposed and its key components are insensitively studied as well. The constructed hardware and software system are put into practical use to support the wind turbines fault diagnosis and verify the accuracy, effectiveness and scalability of the system architecture design.

articleTitle: Rectifer System Design Research of Wind Turbines Grid
publicationTitle: 2017 Second International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: In this paper, a control system with unit power factor for the wind turbine grid-side converter is proposed and designed. Rectifier system design of wind turbine grid includes both hardware and software test platforms. Firstly, the filters and primary circuits are introduced in the hardware platform design. Secondly, the control strategy of seven-segment SVPWM and the control flow of the software are discussed in the software design. At last, the grid rectifier is tested and the unit power factor control system is implemented on the basis of the test platform. Experimental results show that the system can provides a faster response, lower output ripple and higher efficiency.

articleTitle: Study and Implementation on the Monitor of Liquid Level of Liquid Scintillator
publicationTitle: 2017 Second International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: This paper presents a method to monitor the liquid level of liquid scintillator which satisfies the requirement of one neutrino experiment. It uses auxiliary infrared LED source and infrared CCD camera to realize non-contact detection of liquid level. Firstly, it is verified that the infrared LED source has no effect on PMT in the liquid scintillator. Then a monitor system of liquid level is designed by industrial PC, power control module, infrared LED source, calibration tube and infrared CCD camera etc. At last, using image preprocessing, image segmentation, liquid level positioning and liquid level measurement and other image processing techniques, the measurement of liquid level of liquid scintillator meets the requirement and the error is within ±2mm.

articleTitle: AI-Driven Question-Answer Service Matching
publicationTitle: 2017 Second International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: In view of the information redundancy of search results and the differences between user requirements and service matching, this paper presents a service matching technology on the basis of the intelligent question-answer system. Based on the OWL-S, a new service description rule is proposed. This paper tries to achieve question-answer service matching with the service matching algorithm, which combines the matching degree of service input parameters with the node similarity of service mapping ontology to achieve. The experimental results show that this method can significantly improve the accuracy of service matching, which helps to lay a good foundation for the intelligent question-answer system.

articleTitle: FPGA-based Matrix Keyboard Common IP Core Design and the Implementation Using Verilog HDL
publicationTitle: 2017 Second International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: A common IP core design of FPGA-based matrix keyboard is introduced. The design uses Verilog HDL and Altera's Cyclone II series FPGA-EP2C5T144 chip as carrier to achieve the matrix keys control. The results show that the design is an effective way to achieve matrix keys control.

articleTitle: Kinematic Analysis of Tokamak In-Vessel Orbiting Robot
publicationTitle: 2017 Second International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: Tokamak In-Vessel Orbiting robot is mainly used for carrying working robot, which carries out maintenance operations in vessel. With the forward and inverse kinematic algorithms, the continuous path trajectory planning methods are used according to different posture of the robot. The relational curves of these joints angular displacement, angular velocity and angular acceleration are educed by this method. With these movement curves of the joint and the relative position between the circular orbit and the orbit extending robot, we have gotten the movement curves of the three kinematic units belonged to the orbit extending robot, which is smooth and continuous.

articleTitle: Underwater Mission Planning Algorithm of Mustered Helicopters
publicationTitle: 2017 Second International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: This paper discusses the mission planning problem of helicopters mustered to search the underwater target in the appointed area. The dipping sonar is considered to be used based on the analysis of different searching machines. The mission planning including the computation of search time, the coordinates of the detection dots, is proposed to solve the mission planning problem. Finally, the solution and an example of the proposed algorithm are given.

articleTitle: Affine Motion Model Based Rolling Shutter Removal Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2017 Second International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: Geometric distortions may appear in videos captured by rolling shutter cameras. Existing rolling shutter rectification algorithms can remove these distortions effectively, but they are slow and complex. It is hard for mobile devices to satisfy the requirements of these algorithms. An affine motion model based fast algorithm is proposed. This algorithm first use point correspondences to estimate the affine transformation between local image patches. Then, simple curve interpolation is performed for each element in the affine matrices to get the parameters of the motion model. At last, a new image without distortion is generated using the motion model. The experimental results on synthetic data sets and real videos show that the proposed algorithm is accurate and fast.

articleTitle: One Key Reset System for Substation Robot Based on Multi-sensor Fusion
publicationTitle: 2017 Second International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: Aiming at the problem that the equipment in the substation are large and the robot is prone to collision in the substation, one key reset system for the substation equipment live maintenance robot based on multi-sensor fusion is designed. The one key reset system is based on the multi-sensor fusion system. The controller realizes the fusion of multi-sensor information. The system will reset the actuators according to the priority, and prevent the robot from colliding with the substation equipment. The system can make the robot complete automatic reset, and to ensure the safety of the robot operation.

articleTitle: A Location Method for Ceramic Tile Based on the Combination Features
publicationTitle: 2017 Second International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: Locating and sorting of ceramic tile is performed by human observations in most factories. To improve the efficiency of ceramic tile location, an image processing method is proposed in this paper. At first, the Gauss pyramid model is constructed to reduce the search space, the segmentation algorithm and 8 neighborhood chain code are adopted to obtain the contour of ceramic tile, and then combination features vector is generated from contour primitive characteristics and color space separately. Finally, the optimized parameters from feature distribution and a discriminant function are utilized to achieve target recognition. The experiment is conducted on an assembly line with two SCARA robots, and the results show that the proposed method is effective and meets the real-time requirements in complex environment.

articleTitle: A Novel Feature Map for Human Activity Recognition
publicationTitle: 2017 Second International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: In this paper, a novel feature map method for human activity recognition is proposed, which is used to process the adopted raw motion sensing data. Firstly, the feature of the raw data is described by using a novel feature map. Secondly, we use the Sift algorithm to extract the features in the feature map, and the word bag method is utilized to describe these features. Finally, the support vector machine is adopted for classification. The experimental results show that the recognition accuracy of the method is 94.3%, which demonstrates that the novel feature map method is effective.

articleTitle: Investigation on Measurement for Micro Unbalance of Tiny Cylindrical Rollers of the High-Speed Precision Rolling Bearings
publicationTitle: 2017 Second International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: As one of the critical infrastructure components in modern industry, the high-speed precision rolling bearings are widely equipped on high-end advanced equipment. It is stringent requirement for China to develop the precision measurement technology about how to measure the unavoidable micro residual unbalance of the bearings' tiny cylindrical rollers, which seriously affects the performance and service life of high-speed precision rolling bearings. A tiny cylindrical roller is a rotor without shaft which cannot be mounted at rotor-bearing systems directly and the vibration response excited by micro unbalance is difficult to be detected and easy to be messed up with background noise. To make the precision measurement feasible, a soft support mounting bracket is designed. To measure the μm amplitude of vibration of mounting bracket, a high precision laser-based non-contact measurement system consisting of a roller rotation drive system, a vibration signal acquisition system and a signal process system are developed as well. Finally, the validity of the proposed measurement system is verified by comparing the measurement results of a standard roller and a special prepared unbalanced roller.

articleTitle: Design of a Metronome Based on the Idea of "ANDON"
publicationTitle: 2017 Second International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: The ANDON system comes from the lean production management idea of Toyota's automobile manufacturing and is a tool for the lean management of the production process, which is widely used in the field of automobile manufacturing. The purpose of the application is to make the production smooth and improve the efficiency. This metronome program design based on the "security lights" ideas, through a clear station rhythm,to enhance the abnormal corresponding capacity of the production line and eliminate the instability of manual routing, the establishment of fast and transparent production management model, can effectively improve the production efficiency, increase production.

articleTitle: Parametric Design of Complex Elastic Components
publicationTitle: 2017 Second International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: In order to reduce the development cycle of complex elastic components and improve the design efficiency, the three-dimensional parametric design of the complex elastic components is carried out by means of modern digital design. Taking the UG10.0 as the three - dimensional parametric design platform, the elastic mechanics calculation method is used to establish the mathematical expressions between the geometric dimension of the elastic components and the load that the complex elastic components sustained. The three-dimensional parametric model, which describes the relationship between the geometrical dimensions of elastic components and the conditional variables such as the whole and the load, is established by mathematical expressions. The finite element analysis and verification are carried out by using NX NASTRAN. The results show that the parametric model obtained by changing the geometric size or load parameters satisfies the actual working requirements, and the intelligent three - dimensional parametric design of the complex elastic components and components is realized.

articleTitle: Trace Function Representation of m-Subsequence
publicationTitle: 2017 Second International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: m-subsequence is constructed by interchanging successors of a pair of intersecting conjugate state in the states diagram of given m-sequence, and it is a kind of nonlinear feedback shift register sequence with the same period as the generating m-sequence. Trace function representation is an important tools for designing and analyzing pseudo-random sequences. Considering the construction of m-subsequence, a representation method of m-subsequence is presented, which is based on the trace function representation, rather than classical discrete Fourier transform, of the generating m-sequence. The correctness of the presented representation method is also proved.

articleTitle: Effect of Disc Size on Natural Frequency and Stress Distribution in Adhesively Bonded Steel Structure
publicationTitle: 2017 Second International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: The effect of disc size (from 230 mm to 260 mm) on the natural frequency and the stress distribution in the adhesively bonded steel disc structure is studied using the elasto-plastic finite element method (FEM). The results from the numerical analysis show that the natural frequency of the adhesively bonded steel structure is decreased as the diameter of the disc increased. The peak values of all the stress components and the von Mises equivalent stress in the mid-bondline along the direction of the radius are increased as the diameter of the disc increased. The maximum values of the stresses are occurred at the points near the inner edge and the minimum ones are occurred at the points in the region near the outer edge for a certain disc size. The maximum values of the radial and the 1st principal stress are also occurred at the point near the inner edge but the ones of the circumferential and equivalent stress are occurred a distance away from the inner edge in the adherend near the interface along the direction of the radius. The minimum values of all the stresses are occurred at the points in the region near the outer edge.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of the Program of Customer Risk Monitoring and Scoring for Risk Early Warning
publicationTitle: 2017 Second International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: In the domestic commercial banks, the credit rating of the public customers is a very important business indicator. The traditional method of rating is unreal, not objective, and delay. The scheme described in this paper is based on large data technology, making full use of data both inside and outside the bank, setting up multi-latitude risk warning rules. The bank scores the customer's risk status based on these rules. The scheme adopted in this scenario reveals the risk information for the client. The scheme has the characteristics of fast, flexible and timely. This paper introduces the design idea and the concrete realization process of the scheme.

articleTitle: Study on Inherent Frequency Parameters of Planetary Transmission System Based on Power Dual Branch
publicationTitle: 2017 Second International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: The paper studied on the inherent frequency parameters of double branch of the degree of gears alternating meshing impact of planetary transmission system (PTS). The purpose of the research work was to provide the important basis for the optimization design of system response, and then achieved the effect of vibration and noise reduction. Selecting alternating meshing gears parameters could balance the planetary transmission system design objectives, such as load distribution between planetary gears, avoid resonance, and reduce the balance weight of these three design goals, and could be achieved by adjusting the alternating meshing gears parameters of the planetary transmission system. The influence degree of gear meshing stiffness and its torsional stiffness parameters on planetary transmission system was proposed. And the inherent frequencies of vibration modes with varying parameters were analyzed intuitively by modal energy method.

articleTitle: Optimized Selection of Merit Function in Computer-Aided Alignment of Precision Optical System
publicationTitle: 2017 Second International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: The proper application of computer-aided alignment technology can overcome blindness in the alignment process of precision optical system, and reduce the alignment cycle. In which, reasonable merit function of the system's imaging quality is the primary precondition of successful reverse-solving of misalignment. In this paper, firstly, the relation between misalignment and system wavefront aberration is established through mathematic modeling, and by detailed analysis of the relation between Zernike coefficients, geometric aberration and system imaging quality, the merit function of imaging quality based on weighted Zernike coefficients is proposed so as to avoid the numerical instability and inaccuracy of solution caused by direct adoption of Zernike coefficients. Finally, alignment experiment of one infrared optical system is carried out based on the merit function established, and the result shows that, using the same reverse-solving algorithm, compared with direct adoption of Zernike coefficients, weighted Zernike coefficients adopted as the merit function can improve the imaging quality RMS as much as 17%.

articleTitle: Dynamic Analysis of Varied Gears Meshing Coupled Vibration Models of Marine Power Rear Drive System
publicationTitle: 2017 Second International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: In this paper, we take gear system as research object, and dynamic characteristics of gear pair meshing process as core, our purpose is to increase and improve dynamic performance of water surface warship power rear drive system (PRDS). Based on full consideration of this system components dynamic characteristics, used on theory and method of vibration mechanics, and studied on basic law of vibration, shock and noise in the process of transferring power and movement of water surface warship PRDS. Example analysis results verification by using varied gear engagement coupled vibration model shows that gear pairs end surface meshing line direction relative to the dynamic response of vibration acceleration and RMS value of acceleration under working velocity, the vibration of the gear axial, and the load bearing transmitted to box body bearing hole inner wall. It provides theoretical basis for rear drive system design and manufacture with small vibration, low noise, high reliability and high transmission performance. The varied gear engagement coupled vibration model demonstrated in this paper may be applied for many military systems needed for the dynamic performance when a suitable gear engagement coupled vibration model is developed.

articleTitle: A Sensor Cleaning System Integrated with Rotary Washing and Ultrasonic Cleaning
publicationTitle: 2017 Second International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: A cleaning device for water sensors was developed in this study. The whole device focuses on two ways: water rotary erosion and ultrasonic cleaning. The upper computer software and lower computer software are developed. The system parameters are set on the touch screen and the upper computer software is used with this human-machine interface. The experiments results showed that this cleaning device has a best effect. The service life of the sensor is obviously prolonged. The cost of production is indirectly saved.

articleTitle: Analysis of the Impact of Online Courses on the College Student Learning Habit
publicationTitle: 2017 Second International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: According to a questionnaire survey, online courses do have impacts on the college student learning habit, but the impacts are not very serious: online courses do not have a deep and wide understanding, and college students are not engaged in those courses deeply, they do not get the habit of clicking online courses in campus; it is hardly for online courses to substitute traditional ones. Hence, a guidance system of online course has to be built, which help college students to choose; online course system shall be optimized; which could improve the college students' attentions to online courses.

articleTitle: The Network Data Parallel Parsing Algorithm Based on MapReduce
publicationTitle: 2017 Second International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: With the development of technology, the network speed has been greatly improved. In order to analyze network data efficiently, a distributed parallel analysis algorithm for network data based on MapReduce is proposed. The algorithm can run on Hadoop cluster and has the ability of distributed parallel computing. The experimental results show that the proposed algorithm has good speedup and scalability. The algorithm has the ability to deal with massive network data.

articleTitle: A Pedestrian Detection Method Using Background Modeling and Object Proposal
publicationTitle: 2017 Second International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: As the technique of pedestrian detection has been used in a wide application, the methods of background modeling and object proposal become one of the popular research projects in the field of computer vision. In this article, we review some common methods of background modeling and object proposal, we also analyze basic targets in object proposal and clarify the strength and weakness of these methods. To avoid some disadvantages of common methods particularly low computational efficiency or poor localization quality, we put forward a method combined with Gaussian Mixture Model for background modeling and BING++ (Binarized Normed Gradients for Objectness Estimation) for object proposal for adaptive efficiency in more complex conditions. Finally, we evaluate our method by precision and recall for the localization, and make comparisons of results processed by BING and BING++. It is observed that the detection recall and mean average best overlap of the proposals processed by BING++ is higher than BING, and just with little more time as cost. In sum, BING++ can supple higher localization quality. Respectively, GMM can make detection more adaptive as well as flexible and BING++ can achieve comparable performance in the simulation of pedestrian detection.

articleTitle: Design of On-Line Monitoring System for Wind Turbines Transmission Mechanism
publicationTitle: 2017 Second International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: In order to monitor faults in wind power equipment, an on-line monitoring system based on ADSP-BF518 processor was designed, which could cope with diversified status parameters of Wind turbines transmission mechanism. The on-line monitoring system can realize real-time monitoring of multiple transmission mechanism by means of the network communication. Using PC monitoring software, the status signal can be processed and the characteristic value of signal can be extracted. The application results showed the effectiveness of the monitoring equipment.

articleTitle: Numerical Simulation Method for Three-Dimensional Flow Field of Multistage Axial Flow Compressor
publicationTitle: 2017 Second International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: Numerical simulation method (NSM) as an important technique of computational inside fluid machinery complex blade tip clearance leakage flow has been proposed. Clearance leakage and end wall boundary layer and the blade boundary layer interaction makes the tip clearance flow in showing 3D vortex characteristics due to the clearance leakage. Although the geometric size of blade tip clearance compared with the whole flow passage is very small, but it is on the blade passage nearly 20% regional flows, the tip leakage flow will result in the reduction of the tip near the work efficiency, resulting in channel blockage and local losses increase, therefore the correct prediction of the tip leakage flow phenomenon has important significance on further improve the performance of axial flow compressor rotor and expand the stable working range of the rotor.

articleTitle: Dynamic Management and Application of Spatial Data for Dam Group Safety Monitoring Based on GIS
publicationTitle: 2017 Second International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: There are some matters about dam group safety monitoring spatial information, such as large amount of data, complex structure, difficult to maintain when it changes. To solve these problems, GIS technology is used for dynamic management and application of spatial data. We propose a dynamic management technology flow and a batch information interaction method are formed by classifying and storing the spatial data of dam safety monitoring, and develop the spatial data application service module. It can realize the dynamic management, batch processing and visual application of massive heterogeneous spatial information of dam group safety monitoring, further improve the efficiency of spatial data management, and enhance the maintainability of dam safety automatic monitoring system.

articleTitle: Statistical Analysis of the Relationship between Visual Features and Personality
publicationTitle: 2017 Second International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: With the extensive application of multimedia, the study of user portraits has become a hot spot. The personality is an important component of the user's portrait. In this paper, we use the classic and mature personality model-big five personality traits, and we do not use the traditional feature analysis method, but we use statistical analysis method to analyze the relationship between visual features such as color, expression of the 2000 images marked by 54 people and personality. The results show that fea-tures have a different degree of correlation with personality and some features such as saturation, neutral, happiness have direct impacts on personality.

articleTitle: Precision Cylindricity Error Measurement System Design and Surface Topography Reconstruction
publicationTitle: 2017 Second International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: The mathematical model of cylindricity error measurement based on the roundness errors separating with three point method is presented in this paper. Three key elements, the roundness errors, the radius error of different cross sections and the coordinates of the least square centers of measured cross sections, can be separated by this method. The precision cylindricity error measurement system is designed for cylindricity error measurement, reconstruction and analysis. The sensor installation and adjustment system is designed to improve the precision of the spectral confocal displacement sensors' installation. The measured data is processed with the designed software. 3-Dimensional cylindrical surface topography is reconstructed based on OpenGL technology. The color linear interpolation method is used to show cylindricity error distribution. It could be helpful for engineer to realize visual qualitative analysis of cylindricity error.

articleTitle: Design and Analysis of a Planar Flexible Cable Driven Target Motion Device
publicationTitle: 2017 Second International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: In order to realize the tracking motion of the moving target, a planar flexible target motion simulator is designed in this paper. The kinematic and dynamic models of the planar flexible cable driven target motion simulator are established. The moving space of moving object under different rope angles is analyzed. The trapezoidal velocity planning of moving target is carried out. The design parameters are obtained according to the simulation data. Tracking motion of a predetermined trajectory of a moving target is achieved.

articleTitle: Effect of Torsional Load on the Stress Distribution in Weld-Bonded Steel Disc
publicationTitle: 2017 Second International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: The effect of torsional load (from 20 Nm to 10,000 Nm) on the shear and von Mises equivalent stress distributed in the mid-bondline along the paths of both radius and periphery of the weld-bonded steel disc is investigated using the elasto-plastic finite element method (FEM). The results from the numerical analysis show that the peak values of the shear and von Mises equivalent stress are increased as the torsional load increased. And the influence of the torsional load is evidently to the values of the stress both shear and von Mises equivalent stress at the point near the outer edge of the disc but it is not evidently to that ones near the inner edge. The values of the stresses both shear and the equivalent stress along the periphery are nearly kept as the same to a certain torsional load. The maximum values of the stress of shear and von Mises equivalent stress along the direction of both radius and periphery is directly proportional to the torsional load but the slope of line for the maximum values of the stress along the direction of radius is higher than that one along the periphery.

articleTitle: An Online Name Disambiguation Method Based on Entity and Property Co-occurrence
publicationTitle: 2017 Second International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: Name disambiguation plays an important role in text processing. Names in natural language text are usually ambiguous, as many people share a same name, so do organizations and entities in other domains. The goal of name disambiguation is to identify the different referents of a same name in corpus. Technology of name disambiguation can be applied in web searching, information extraction, translation system, questioning-answer system, and so on. The key part to solving name ambiguity problem is to model context of names and feature of candidates, and then measure similarity. We proposed a representation, Bag of Entity with Property, BoEwP, to model a document, the context of names. Then, we presented an online disambiguation method for person or organization names based on entity and property co-occurrence. We performed experiments on Chinese, Spanish and English corpus. Our approach got nice precision and recall measurements, and required low system resources.

articleTitle: A Review on Entity Relation Extraction
publicationTitle: 2017 Second International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: Because of large amounts of unstructured data generated on the Internet, entity relation extraction is believed to have high commercial value. Entity relation extraction is a case of information extraction and it is based on entity recognition. This paper firstly gives a brief overview of relation extraction. On the basis of reviewing the history of relation extraction, the research status of relation extraction is analyzed. Then the paper divides theses research into three categories: supervised machine learning methods, semi-supervised machine learning methods and unsupervised machine learning method, and toward to the deep learning direction.

articleTitle: Task Classification: Towards Tasks Correlation for Combinatorial Auction Mechanism in Crowdsourcing
publicationTitle: 2017 Second International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: People experience a revolution of society when the crowdsourcing period comes. The social reform changed the way of work and lifestyle. And the popularity of crowdsourcing has brought a new opportunity for mobile computing and online auctions. Because of the significance of incentivizing worker participation in crowdsourcing system, the correlative theories of auction-based incentive mechanisms have been proposed in past literature. Combinatorial auctions can be used to reach efficient resource and task allocations in Multi-agent systems where the items are complementary or substitutable. Although many good auction-based incentive mechanisms can attract more participation, facing a large-scale of complex social perception tasks in the market, a combinatorial auction mechanism which simply relies on to allocate resources is not efficiently. In order to solve this problem, we design two algorithm models to classify all crowdsourcing-tasks into many groups according to the intentions that the workers provided, and then the workers and the crowdsourcing platform start the combinatorial auction for each task-group. The first model, namely the frequent-driven model, adopts correlation analysis technology, and the second model, namely weight-driven model, use a method that combines the concept of weight and the hierarchical clustering technology to solve problems.
